privacy_policy_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how I, Rahni De-Meis, collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you use my website, create an account, purchase my handmade products or contact me. By using my website, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
privacy_policy_info: I may collect personal information that you provide directly to me when you: create an account, place an order, contact me or otherwise interact with my website.
privacy_policy_payment: I do not store or have direct access to your payment card details. Payments are processed by Braintree. Payment information is handled directly by the payment provider in accordance with its own privacy policy and security practices. I recommend reviewing the payment provider's privacy policy for further information about how your payment information is processed.
privacy_policy_use: I use your personal information only where necessary to operate my website, process your orders, provide my services, and communicate with you. This may include using your information to: process and fulfil orders; arrange delivery of your purchases; send order confirmations, receipts, and delivery updates; manage your customer account; respond to questions and customer support requests; maintain the security of my website; prevent fraud or misuse of my services; and improve my website, products, and customer experience. I will only process your personal information where I have a lawful basis to do so, such as fulfilling a contract with you, complying with a legal obligation, pursuing my legitimate interests, or obtaining your consent where consent is required. When information is necessary to create an account, process an order, arrange delivery, or comply with a legal obligation, I will indicate which information is required. If you do not provide required information, I may be unable to create your account, process your order, or provide the requested service.
privacy_policy_sharing: I do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. I may share limited personal information with trusted third-party service providers where this is necessary to operate my business and provide my services. For example, this may include: payment processors, to process payments; postal services and delivery couriers, to deliver your orders; website hosting and infrastructure providers, to operate my website; email or newsletter providers, where applicable; and other service providers that assist me with operating my website or business. These providers will only receive the information necessary for the service they provide and, where applicable, are required to protect your information and process it only for the purposes for which it was provided. I may also disclose information where required to do so by law or where necessary to protect my legal rights, prevent fraud, or protect the security of my website and its users.
privacy_policy_data: I retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Privacy Policy. Account and customer information may be retained while your account remains active or while I need the information to provide my services. I may retain certain order, transaction, and financial information for longer where this is necessary to comply with legal, accounting, tax, or other regulatory obligations. Where you request deletion of your personal information, I will delete information that I no longer have a legal or legitimate reason to retain, subject to any applicable legal retention requirements.
privacy_policy_rights: Depending on the circumstances and applicable law, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you may have the right to: request access to the personal information I hold about you; request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information; request deletion of your personal information; request restriction of certain processing; object to certain uses of your personal information; request portability of information you have provided to me; withdraw your consent where I rely on your consent to process your information; and lodge a complaint with your data protection authority if you believe your data has been processed unlawfully. To exercise any of these rights or ask questions about how I process your information, please contact me through my contact page: [CONTACT PAGE URL]
privacy_policy_cookies: I use essential cookies and similar technologies that are necessary for the website to function correctly. For example, cookies may be used to: keep items in your shopping cart; maintain your login session; remember necessary website settings; and provide essential security and functionality. If I use additional, non-essential cookies, such as analytics or advertising cookies, I will provide the appropriate information and, where required by law, obtain your consent before using them. You can also manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the website.
privacy_policy_security: I take reasonable technical measures to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of transmitting or storing information online can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
